verdict.rationale: TypeSafe ships official Python (typesafe-sdk) and JavaScript/TypeScript (@typesafe-ai/sdk) SDKs. Both have install instructions, API reference pages (async client, retry policy, models, usage, typed errors), a changelog and documented automatic retries. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the official SDKs, since the community reports describe API/OpenRouter use rather than the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Our client SDKs provide typed questions and answers for the TypeSafe API and handle retries automatically with their default retry policy.
JavaScript and TypeScript SDK for [TypeSafe AI](https://typesafe.ai).
Use AsyncTypeSafeClient to ask questions, list models, and configure asynchronous TypeSafe API requests.
